name: 酒店行业监测团队
description: 酒店行业监测团队：监视位读星级饭店季度口径、出游与出入境需求、欧盟住宿序列与 33 家酒店公司财务细分并给出缺口归因；合成位交叉复核产出值守记录；产出位落草稿产物。只读纪律，不写观测、不发布对外产物。
notes: 只读监测团队：数据面取自行观测库（星级饭店季度 / 出游与出入境 / 欧盟住宿 / 33 家酒店公司财务细分）与披露事件，产物只落草稿不发布。不可得项逐条列出（民航客运、客房数、中国住宿业 CPI、美国住宿业销售、日本宿泊、BLS 住宿价格、欧盟住宿价格指数、台股/日股/欧股车道缺失、A股 2024 后无经营简报）。口径铁律：星级饭店≠全行业、50 城小计≠全国、停更系列≠当期、年度与累计期不并线。

en.name: Hotel Industry Watch Team
en.description: Three-role monitoring team for the hotel sector: monitor reads star-rated hotel quarterly data, travel demand, EU accommodation series and 33 hotel companies' financial breakdowns with gap attribution; synthesizer cross-checks and drafts the duty log; producer turns it into a draft artifact. Read-only; never publishes.
en.notes: Read-only monitoring. Four universes are never mixed (star-rated hotels / industry association / company self-reported / EU). Unavailable items are always listed explicitly; nothing is imputed or zero-filled.

hotel-watch-discipline.description: Hotel watch discipline: four universes never mixed, three-way missing-data triage (never_held / gap_in_series / not_applicable), no imputation, trend thresholds, read-only boundaries.
